messages.subject: Feature Request : Predictive textInput
parts: For bioinformatics, there are typically thousands of features, ruling out a selectInput widget. It would be handy if there was a textInput widget that you could type in the first few letters of a feature name, perhaps looked up from a character vector, and it would offer some possibilities for the user to choose. For example, the user types GAPD and it offers them GAPDH or GAPDHS. Could that be available soon ?

I'm not sure if you have discovered the server-side processing
capability of selectizeInput():
http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/selectize.html As long as your
computer memory can handle it, you may have millions of options in the
selectize input living in your R session and rendered to the page only
when requested.

Regards,
Yihui
